name: The landlord's notice
prompt: A notice is taped to your door. The landlord will inspect the flat tomorrow morning.

outcome.told: You decide the flat is fine the way it is.
outcome.line: {you} left the flat as it was for the landlord's inspection.

failure.told: The landlord writes up the kitchen and charges a cleaning fee.
failure.line: {you} was charged a cleaning fee after an inspection.

outcome.told: You scrub the stove and take out three bags of rubbish.
outcome.line: {you} cleaned the flat before the landlord's inspection.
